review_scope: Visual and structural QA only; no legal semantic parsing performed

observations.finding: Page 1 has a single-column chapter introduction above a two-column regulatory body.
observations.action: Added a page-1 top-band rule that assigns the title and user note to the spanning column.

observations.finding: Pages 2 through 18 use a two-column body layout.
observations.action: Retained coordinate-based left-column then right-column reading order.

observations.finding: Eight automatically detected table candidates correspond to visible tables.
observations.action: Separated 189 table-region source lines from ordinary paragraph nodes and retained their line provenance.

observations.finding: The first structural pass treated some ordinary lines beginning with cross-reference numbers as new provisions.
observations.action: Restricted provision starts to numbered lines whose first meaningful span is bold.

observations.finding: The first structural pass duplicated section heading text and did not attach sections to the chapter root.
observations.action: Removed duplicate heading concatenation and made Sections 1101 through 1112 children of Chapter 11.

final_visual_assessment: The retained page images and contact sheets show one mixed-layout opening page, seventeen two-column pages, consistent running headers and footers, decorative margin bars, and eight tables. No OCR was required.
limitations: Stage 10 legal semantic interpretation was intentionally excluded.
Node boundaries are deterministic layout/typographic results and should receive targeted human review before authoritative RDF publication.
Cross-reference relationships are not yet resolved into graph edges.
